sections.title: One sentence
sections.body: The time interval in which a statement is considered applicable.

sections.title: In plain language
sections.body: A person can have one role last year and a different role today without either historical statement being meaningless.

sections.title: Concrete example
sections.body: A policy applies from January until its replacement in March.

sections.title: In this Knowledge OS
sections.body: Assertions and Decisions support temporal fields and optional as-of reads.

sections.title: Why it exists
sections.body: Time prevents yesterday’s truth from being silently presented as today’s context.

sections.title: Technical detail
sections.body: Validity intervals use [valid_from, valid_to): the start is included and the end excluded. This snapshot does not claim the later temporal remediation is verified.
